 K-Pop Star HYOLYN, Rave Republic & Nils Van Zandt To Perform At Hennessy Artistry 2026
 More artistes to be announced.
 By Tamara Jayne | 05 Nov 2026, 05:37 PM
 Share Share − Enlarge text + Make SAYS your preferred source on Google # entertainment 
 # events

 Cover image via Hennessy Artistry (Provided to SAYS) & @xhyolynx (Instagram) 
 Follow us on  Instagram ,  TikTok , and  WhatsApp  for the latest stories and breaking news. 
 K-pop fans, HYOLYN is coming to KL! And she'll be joined by a whole lineup of international and local acts this November.
 The South Korean singer and former SISTAR member will headline Hennessy Artistry 2026 at Sentul Depot on 21 November .
The event will also bring together DJs, rappers, and performers from Malaysia and around the region, with acts spread across two stages.
 Image via Hennessy Artistry (Provided to SAYS) 
 Joining HYOLYN on the Main Stage are Singaporean DJ duo Rave Republic, Dutch DJ and electronic music producer Nils Van Zandt, Malaysian DJ Mia, and local hip-hop veteran Dato Maw
 There are also two mystery acts in the lineup, so we'll have to wait a little longer to find out who else is performing.
Over at the Community Hall, you can catch a different mix of regional talent, including Malaysian DJs Smooth Brain Girly and Tchuno, Vietnamese rapper Mason Nguyen, and Singaporean hip-hop artistes Axel Brizzy and Yaung. 
 Image via Hennessy Artistry (Provided to SAYS) 
 Image via Hennessy Artistry (Provided to SAYS) 
 Besides catching the acts on stage, visitors can check out a bunch of activities around the Community Hall
 For those who've always wanted to try DJing, there's a public DJ Know-How session by Tchuno. You can also watch her go head-to-head with Smooth Brain Girly in a Face-to-Face Battle.
Street dance fans can catch a performance by Kid Inn and Lego Sam, followed by an open-style dance battle where visitors can show off their moves.
There are also several pop-ups and interactive experiences to explore, including:
 The Story House: Check out Ouro, an illuminated installation by spatial artist Kaiyi, and snap photos at an immersive photography experience.
 ButNotReally Pop-Up: Pick up limited-edition festival merch, including custom-designed tees, retro MP3 players, and squishies.
 Sephora x Hennessy Glam Bar: Touch up your look at the on-site glam stations.
 Create Your Mix: Have a go at creating your own mix through an interactive digital DJ experience.
 Recharge Lounge: Take a break between sets with hydration stations, complimentary hand and shoulder massages, and charging facilities.
 Click to watch a video preview below:
 There's also a reservation-only dining experience featuring a specially created menu by Eat and Cook
 Meanwhile, the Hennessy Bar will be serving cocktails on tap, alongside a curated menu by Penang-based bar The Nest.
 Here's how to get tickets
 Hennessy Artistry 2026 takes place on Saturday, 21 November, from 4pm to midnight at Sentul Depot, Kuala Lumpur.
You can get general admission tickets with the purchase of selected bottles:
 One bottle of Hennessy V.S.O.P (70cl): Two general admission tickets
 One bottle of Hennessy X.O (70cl): Four general admission tickets
There's also something extra for selected ticket holders, who will stand a chance to win a VIP table at the event or three-day VIP passes to EDC Phuket in Thailand this December .
For more updates, giveaways, and the announcement of the remaining performers, follow Hennessy Malaysia's official Facebook page .
